ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point B is a point on line segment AC, and $AB=21$, $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$. If point O is the midpoint of line segment AC, calculate the length of line segment OB.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $O$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
therefore, $OC=\frac{1}{2}AC=14$,\\
therefore, $OB=OC-BC=14-7=\boxed{7}$.
